title: Cotangent complex and differential basis for a polynomial algebra
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative ring and $E$ a set. Put $P=A[x_e\mid e\in E]$. For the standard cotangent complex [lem-trf-cotangent-resolution-coherence] in $D(P)$ [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], the augmentation to universal differentials induces an isomorphism $L_{P/A}\simeq\Omega^1_{P/A}[0]$ [def-weil-pbc-kahler-differentials]. After localizing $P$, this description identifies the cotangent complex with the localized differential module in degree zero.

proof.text: Apply [lem-trf-constant-polynomial-resolution-retraction] to $P=A[x_e\mid e\in E]$. It supplies the constant polynomial resolution $Q_\bullet\to P$, its differential complex $K$, the augmentation homotopy equivalence $a:K\to M[0]$ with $M=\Omega^1_{P/A}$, and the standard evaluation map $v$ with $av$ equal to the canonical differential augmentation. By the resolution-comparison isomorphisms and naturality in [lem-trf-cotangent-resolution-coherence], write $\gamma_Q:K\simeq L_{P/A}$ and $\gamma_{\mathrm{std}}:L_{P/A}\simeq L_{P/A}$ for the comparisons. Naturality gives $\gamma_Q\,Q(v)=\gamma_{\mathrm{std}}$, so $Q(v)=\gamma_Q^{-1}\gamma_{\mathrm{std}}$ is an isomorphism. Thus $av$ is an isomorphism in $D(P)$, proving the polynomial clause with the specified augmentation, for any set $E$.

source.place: Tags 08QG (lemma-pi-lower-shriek-polynomial-algebra), 08QH (lemma-cotangent-complex-polynomial-algebra), 08QI (remark-resolution), and 08QL (section-functoriality): explicit constant-resolution contraction and evaluation formulas from returned proof Steps 1--2.

proof.text: By [lem-weil-pbc-polynomial-ring-kahler-basis-any-variables], $M=\bigoplus_{e\in E}P\,\mathrm dx_e$, and $\mathrm dg=\sum_e(\partial g/\partial x_e)\,\mathrm dx_e$ with finite support. For $C=T^{-1}P$, its base-changed basis is $(1\otimes\mathrm dx_e)_{e\in E}$ in $C\otimes_PM$. This records the differential basis without asserting finite rank for infinite $E$.

source.place: algebra.tex Tag 00RX (lemma-differentials-polynomial-ring), arbitrary-variable version of its universal-derivation proof.

proof.text: For any multiplicative subset $T\subseteq P$, apply [lem-trf-cotangent-augmentation-localization] to $A\to B=P$. Step 1 verifies its sole conditional hypothesis, that the canonical $a_P$ is a quasi-isomorphism. It gives the quasi-isomorphism $\kappa^{-1}[0]a_C:L_{C/A}\to(T^{-1}M)[0]$ for $C=T^{-1}P$. The lemma's commuting square and generator formula identify this as the localized canonical augmentation, including arbitrary $T$. Under its map $\kappa$, the basis in Step 2 becomes $(\mathrm d(x_e/1))_{e\in E}$, proving the asserted localized description.
